g.text: Native CLIs · shared context · explicit control
Apply permissions to new sessions only? Existing sessions are
unchanged; dispatch grants will be cleared. Mode: ENFORCE. Network:
Only the project is persistently writable. Approved references and standard OS runtime trees are read-only; temporary
HOME/tmp are disposable. Other user folders and host procfs are hidden. Install Forge outside the project. Bubblewrap
is required; unsupported hosts fail closed. Grants apply to NEW sessions; existing sessions retain their old
permissions. Network allowance exposes host networking, not a provider-only firewall. Native Windows/macOS isolation is
Local ledger ready. Models status is shown in F6; /launch or /task to begin coding.
